instruction: Set up a column 80 vertical ruler in the VS Code editor across all file types.

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a ruler at column 80 in VSCode user settings. The evaluator uses the existing check_json_settings function to verify that editor.rulers is set to [80] in the settings.json file. This is related to the original task which deals with line length settings, and has similar complexity - both require modifying VSCode global settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement
Getter (get_vm_file) extracts the correct state - VSCode settings.json from user profile
Metric (check_json_settings) correctly compares expected vs actual settings - checks if editor.rulers is set to [80]
Expected value [80] semantically matches the instruction requirement for column 80 ruler
Complete coverage - instruction has single requirement (add ruler at column 80) and evaluator checks exactly this
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - accesses expected['expected'] which receives the rules dict from get_rule
Data flow is correct: VM file -> JSON load -> key-value comparison
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Static type warnings are false positives - get_vm_file returns str for single file mode, check_json_settings handles None case correctly
Consider edge case: if settings.json doesn't exist on VM, get_vm_file returns None, and check_json_settings returns 0.0 (correctly fails)

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
